feed.title: Track Magictools Updates Weekly
feed.subtitle: :video_game: :pencil: A list of Game Development resources to make magic happen.

entry.title: Magictools Updates on Oct 26 - Nov 01, 2026
entry.content:
Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🆓 PicMason Sprite Sheet Splitter - Browser-based fixed-grid splitter with custom frame sizes, offsets and spacing. Exports PNG frames preserving source transparency and a ZIP with source coordinates; can skip fully transparent frames.

Graphics / Bitmap Compression

  • 💸 BatchSet - Compress and convert whole folders of PNG, JPG and WebP sprites in the browser, nothing uploaded.

Graphics / Texture Tools

  • 🎉 MeshCoat - Fast, offline desktop texture painter: load a 3D model and paint PBR materials directly onto the mesh, then export texture maps. Source (⭐11)
  • 🎉 Sprite Fusion Sprite Normals (⭐113) - Generate normal maps from pixel art sprites and animations.

Graphics / Animation

  • 🎉 MeshAnimate - Pivot-style pose-to-pose animator for rigged Blender characters, with a simple timeline and onion-skin ghosts. Saves animations back into the .blend as normal Blender actions. Source (⭐4)
  • 🎉 MeshRig - Rig any mesh in a .blend in minutes: fit a starting skeleton, skin weights and IK. Writes a standard Blender armature that works anywhere a Blender rig does. Source (⭐3)

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 💸 Pic2SVG - Raster-to-vector tracing preview for inspecting flat artwork intended for game icons or UI. Free anonymous split preview and enlarged view; downloads require Pro. Images are processed on the server.

Graphics / Modeling

  • 🎉 Inca - Free, open-source 3D modeling, animation and rendering app that works like Maya 2020, with OBJ, FBX, glTF and STL import.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 RespawnStack - Free directory of pricing, commercial-use and ownership terms for 30+ AI game-dev tools. Each verified row cites its source (vendor page or Steamworks docs) with a link and date.
  • 🆓 StarterLoot - Free directory of 80+ beginner friendly AI game dev tools, with guides like Godot vs Unity.
  • 🆓 WishlistForge Steam Description Scorer - free in-browser scorer for Steam short descriptions. It checks length, hook, genre clarity, player fantasy and call to action, and suggests a rewrite. No account needed.

Collections / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 DailySounds - Searchable sound effects for games, with browser previews and downloadable audio; free for commercial projects under the DailySounds license.
  • 🆓 PulseLite UI SFX - 20 free UI sounds (clicks, hovers, confirms, errors, rewards) in WAV/OGG, procedurally synthesized with no samples or AI audio models, sounds CC BY 4.0, plus an optional Godot 4 drop-in script (MIT).

Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 CICA AUDIO - AI sound effect generator for games and UI. Analyzes gameplay recordings, detects sound events, and generates synchronized WAV files.
  • 🎉 Slip Sound - Fast, local desktop audio sample manager for searching and organizing large sound libraries. No accounts or file caps, with MCP support. Source (⭐11)

Project Management / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Gamifying - Browser workspace for game design: characters, quests, items and lore as linked entries, with Kanban board, timeline and JSON export.
entry.summary: 16 awesome projects updated on Oct 26 - Nov 01, 2026

  • 🆓 Blender 3D models - 3D models, particle systems/effects
  • 💸 GameDev Market - a community-driven marketplace that connects indie game developers with talented asset creators.
  • 🆓 Matcaps (⭐3.4k) - A Huge library of matcap textures in PNG and ZMT, organized by color.
  • 🆓 Sketchfab - Publish & embed interactive 3D models.
  • 🆓 TextureHaven - Free textures with additional maps like displacement and bump maps. Also HDRIs.

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🎉 Cheetah-Texture-Packer (⭐254) - High efficient and fast 2D bin packing tool
  • 🎉 Libgdx Texture Packer (⭐25k) - Texture Packer built into Libgdx
  • 🆓 ShoeBox - Adobe Air based app with game and ui related tools.
  • 💸 TexturePacker - Great spritesheet creation editor.

Graphics / Bitmap Compression

  • 🆓 PNGoo - Windows GUI for batch conversion.
  • 💸 TinyPNG - Advanced lossy compression for PNG images that preserves full alpha transparency.

Graphics / Texture Tools

  • 💰 FilterForge - A plugin for Adobe Photoshop that allows you to build your own filters.
  • 🆓 Live Normal - An Android and iOS app for generating seamless materials on the go. You take a photo, and Live Normal creates a tile-able texture and generates texture maps ready for a PBR engine of your choice.

Graphics / Tile/Level Editors

  • 🎉 LDtk - LDtk is an open-source 2D level editor for indie devs, with a strong focus on user-friendliness.
  • 🎉 OGMO Editor- generic level editor.
  • 🎉 Overlap2D (⭐794) - a 2D level and UI editor with an engine agnostic philosophy.

Graphics / Animation

  • 💰 Mixamo - tool for auto auto rigging and animation of 3D humanoid models,

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 💰 Affinity Designer - Vector graphics editor with a bunch of features which also supports Adobe file formats
  • 💰 Affinity Photo - Photo and raster graphics editor which works together with Adobe file formats and Affinity Designer
  • 🎉 Inkscape - An open-source vector graphics editor similar to Adobe Illustrator, Corel Draw, Freehand, or Xara X.
  • 🎉 Krita - Krita is a professional FREE and open source painting program. It is made by artists that want to see affordable art tools for everyone.
  • 🎉 LibreSprite - LibreSprite is an open source fork of Aseprite.
  • 💰 Pickle - Another Pixel art Editor.
  • 💰 Pixen (⭐932) - Pixel Art Editor for OSX
  • 🆓 REXPaint - a powerful and user-friendly ASCII art editor.
  • 🎉 rx - a modern & minimalist pixel editor
  • 🆓 Tilemancer - A quick procedural tile creator designed for pixel-art games.

Graphics / Modeling

  • 🆓 MakeHuman
  • 💰 modo

Graphics / Terrain Generators

  • 🆓 Canyon Terrain Editor - Create quality, realistic terrain quickly and intuitively
  • 🎉 DEM Net Elevation API - Live 3D textured terrain generation from real data - export height/normal maps, glTF, OBJ, STL
  • 🎉 Fracplanet - Fractal planet and terrain generator
  • 💰 World Creator - Procedural terrain and landscape generation on the GPU in real time, simulation of erosion and sediment, beautiful editor. much more

Graphics / Voxel Editors

  • 🎉 goxel (⭐3.2k)
  • 🆓 MagicaVoxel

Engines and Frameworks / Voxel Editors

  • 🎉 Astera (⭐301) - 2D C99 Cross Platform Game Library / Framework
  • 🎉 Babylon.js - Javascript 3D Library.
  • 🎉 Bevy - A refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust
  • 🎉 bgfx (⭐18k) - Cross-platform, graphics API agnostic, "Bring Your Own Engine/Framework" style rendering library.
  • 🎉 bitsy - A little editor for little games or worlds. The goal is to make it easy to make games where you can walk around and talk to people and be somewhere.
  • 🎉 Bladecoder (⭐647) - Classic point and click adventure game engine and editor.
  • 🎉 Blitz3D (⭐292) 3D basic-like programming language for fast 3D desktop games.
  • 🎉 Cinder - Cinder is a community-developed, free and open source library for professional-quality creative coding in C++.
  • 🎉 Cocos2D (⭐636) - graphic library for games and multimedia, for python language
  • 🎉 Coquette - A micro framework for JavaScript games. Handles collision detection, the game update loop, canvas rendering, and keyboard and mouse input.
  • 🎉 Dash (⭐425) - A free and open 3D game engine written in D.
  • 🎉 Dear Imgui (⭐77k) - A bloat-free immediate mode GUI for C++ with minimal dependencies.
  • 🎉 DEM Net Elevation API C# (⭐357) - Terrain generation from real data with textures, normal maps, glTF, OBJ, STL support
  • 🎉 Diligent Engine (⭐4.5k) - A modern cross-platform low-level graphics library that supports Direct3D11, Direct3D12, OpenGL/GLES, and Vulkan.
  • 🎉 Ebiten - A dead simple 2D game library in Go.
  • 🎉 ecs-lib (⭐217) - ecs-lib is a tiny and easy to use ECS (Entity Component System) library for game programming. It's written in Typescript but you can use on node.js and web browser too.
  • 🎉 ENGi (⭐392) - A multi-platform 2D game library for Go.
  • 🎉 engo - Engo is an open-source 2D game engine written in Go.
  • 🎉 EnTT (⭐13k) - Gaming meets modern C++, a fast and reliable entity-component system (ECS) and much more
  • 🎉 Farseer (⭐750) - a collision detection system with realistic physics responses.
  • 🎉 Flame (⭐11k) - a minimalist game engine for Flutter
  • 🎉 FlashPunk - free ActionScript 3 library designed for developing 2D Flash games.
  • 🎉 FXGL (⭐4.9k) - A JavaFX/Kotlin game engine for Win/Mac/Linux.
  • 🎉 gameplay - A free, open-source, cross-platform, 2D + 3D game framework written in C++. It is aimed towards indie game developers who are creating desktop and mobile games.
  • 💸 GameSalad - Game Creation Engine for Mac and Windows.
  • 🎉 GB Studio - A free and easy to use retro adventure game creator for your favourite handheld video game system.
  • 🎉 GDevelop - An open-source, cross-platform 2D game engine designed for everyone - it's extensible, fast and easy to learn.
  • 🎉 Glide Engine (⭐505) - Engine for making 2d games on iOS, macOS and tvOS in Swift programming language, with practical examples and tutorials.
  • 🎉 Gorgon - A 2D rendering API for .NET, written in C#.
  • 🎉 Heaps - Cross platform graphics for high performance games.
  • 🎉 iio.js (⭐457) - A javascript library that speeds the creation and deployment of HTML5 Canvas applications
  • 🎉 Juno (⭐169) - Framework for making 2D games with chunky pixels in Lua
  • 🎉 Kivent - A 2D game framework for Kivy.
  • 🎉 LibGDX - Powerful (totally free) library for Java, code once and run the game on desktop, Android, Web, and iOS.
  • 🎉 LumixEngine (⭐3.9k) - 3D Game engine built on C++.
  • 🎉 Nakama (⭐14k) - Distributed server for social and realtime games and apps.
  • 🎉 nCine - A cross-platform 2D game engine with an emphasis on performance, written in C++11 and optionally scriptable in Lua.
  • 🆓 NodeBox - a family of Python tools to create generative design.
  • 🎉 openFrameworks - An open source and free C++ toolkit for creative coding.
  • 🎉 Panda3D - a framework for 3D rendering and game development for Python and C++ programs.
  • 💸 PlayCanvas - A WebGL Game Engine.
  • 🎉 Processing - Processing is a programming language, development environment for artists, designers, researchers.
  • 🎉 Rajawali (⭐2.4k) - Android OpenGL ES 2.0/3.0 Engine
  • 🎉 raylib - a simple and easy-to-use library to enjoy videogames programming, hardware accelerated with OpenGL (1.1, 2.1, 3.3 or ES 2.0)
  • 🎉 Superpowers - HTML5 Collaborative 2D/3D Game Maker
  • 🎉 TIC-80 - TIC-80 is a fantasy computer for making, playing and sharing tiny games.
  • 🎉 ursina - A game engine powered by python and panda3d.
  • 🎉 voxel.js - voxel.js is a collection of projects that make it easier than ever to create 3D voxel games like Minecraft all in the browser.
  • 🎉 WhiteStorm.js (⭐6.4k) - 3d javacript framework for building apps and games
  • 🎉 ÖbEngine (⭐868) - 2D Game Engine with Lua Scripting made on top of SFML !

  • 🎉 SimpleAI (⭐177) - C++11 behaviour tree based library with a QT5 based remote debugger (and with optional LUA bindings) released under MIT.
